execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."ai_detected_items" (
  "confidence_score" float8 NOT NULL,
  "detected_component" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "scan_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ai_reviews" (
  "comments" text,
  "decision" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewer_id" text NOT NULL,
  "scan_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ai_scans" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text NOT NULL,
  "loan_id" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "resource" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."component_categories" (
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."components" (
  "available_quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "category_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "total_quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dispute_evidences" (
  "dispute_id" text NOT NULL,
  "file_url" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "uploaded_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."disputes" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "loan_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_transactions" (
  "component_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity_change" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reference_id" text,
  "transaction_type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."kit_components" (
  "component_id" text NOT NULL,
  "kit_id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("kit_id", "component_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."kits" (
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kit_code" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loan_items" (
  "component_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "loan_id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loan_status_histories" (
  "changed_by" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "loan_id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loans" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "due_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "loan_code" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."qr_codes" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" text NOT NULL,
  "entity_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."system_configs" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_roles" (
  "role_id" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "full_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "student_code" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
